title: Detect whether two variables are the same object
statement: Define a Box class with a public attribute content. Read a flag (1 or 0). Create a Box in variable a. If the flag is 1, make b the same object as a; if it is 0, create a new Box for b. Write 1 if a and b are the same object, or 0 if not.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
